characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 24" of this model. Friendly ^^**Adeptus Astartes**^^ units’ [Melta]/[Torrent] attacks that target that enemy unit have +2 S.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The first time this model is set up on the battlefield, select one objective on the battlefield. While this model is within range of that objective, this model has:


- 10 OC.
- 5+ Ld.
- Feel No Pain 4+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time an attack would lose this model a wound, roll one D6: on a 4+ the wound is ignored. (This is in addition to its 5+ Invulnerable Save.)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model cannot be your Warlord while any other Character in your army can serve as Warlord. It can still gain a Warlord Trait when fielded in an all-Dreadnought force.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model destroys an enemy Monster or Vehicle, until the end of the battle Burning Wrath and the Dreadfire heavy flamers gain +1 to the Damage characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, in your Movement phase, this model can activate Smoke. Until the start of your next turn, ranged attacks targeting this model suffer -1 to the Hit roll, and this model cannot be selected to shoot.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to the following units: **^^Intercessor Squad^^**, **^^Assault Intercessor Squad^^**, **^^Tactical Squad^^**, **^^Sternguard Veteran Squad^^**, **^^Bladeguard Veteran Squad^^**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of your Movement phase, select one friendly Salamanders Infantry or Salamanders Biker unit within 3" of this model. One of the following effects (your choice):
• Heal: One model in that unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.
• Revive: If no model in that unit is wounded but one or more models have been destroyed during the battle, roll one D6: on a 3+, return one destroyed model to the unit with 1 wound remaining.
If the Revive roll fails, this model cannot shoot, charge, or fight for the rest of the turn (recovering the gene-seed). A unit can only be the target of this ability once per turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a friendly Salamanders model loses a wound while within 3" of this model, you can roll one D6: on a 6, that wound is not lost.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn it Advanced.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can be attached to the following units: **^^Sternguard Veteran Squad^^**, **^^Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs^^**, **^^Bladeguard Veteran Squad^^**, **^^Assault Intercessor Squad^^**, **^^Tactical Squad^^**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While a friendly Salamanders unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this model is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy Character models in the Fight phase, attacks made by this model gain +2 to the Attacks characteristic for the Cinder Edge that phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model uses the Steelsliver melee profile, instead of selecting a single target, make 1 attack against each enemy model within Engagement Range of this model (to a maximum of 6 attacks). Resolve these against the model's unit normally.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this model makes a melee attack with the Cinder Edge against a Monster, Vehicle, or Character target, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.
